invariants.rationale: instantTime is required as an argument and used in multiple method calls without explicit null handling, suggesting it should be non-null.
records is passed to other methods (e.g., HoodieListData.eager(records)) without a null check, suggesting it must be non-null.
userDefinedBulkInsertPartitioner, as an Option, should not be null; Option itself models presence/absence semantics.
bulkInsert on an empty list is unusual and would likely be handled separately; typical calls expect records to contain entries.
instantTime is passed downstream where empty instants are likely not expected.
